text:
maya: Quick kickoff: faststart launch next Tue. Need final on launch post, 30-min demo webinar, credit ladder, starter prompt pack, and inbound routing.
noah: timeline?
maya: post Tue 9am PT, webinar Wed 11am PT, credits issued after webinar.
sam: metric focus = activation (first 5 requests in 24h). baseline 22%. aim +10pp.
olivia: landing should spotlight 3 templates, 1-click run, and ‘$20 free’ CTA. short copy.
rachel: social drafts: 2 tiny prompt examples + link to sign-up. use :rocket:.
ben: routing rule: route to SDRs if company_size>40 OR asks for private/dedicated. otherwise self-serve.
ops-bot: adding routing rule: if company_size>40 or interest contains "private"/"dedicated" -> sales-sdr.
sam: include starter pack templates: support-reply, meeting-summarizer, code-refactor. seeded on landing so users can hit first-5 quickly.
olivia: A/B header variants: A) "Start with templates + $20" B) "Try Redwood: instant templates" (50/50).
rachel: webinar flow: 8m intro, 20m live prompt workshop, 10m Q&A + live incentive (extra $10 for attendees who run 3 requests).
maya: finance ok?
noah: promo cap $3k, per-account cap $40.
ops-bot: created promo bucket 'faststart-webinar-2026' and webhook /promo/claim; idempotency key required.
sam: analytics: emit template_run event with template_id, tokens_used, success. tag signup_source and variant.
maya: action items: noah -> routing + SDR playbook (EOD); ops -> promo bucket + webhook (4h); rachel+olivia -> landing & post copy + webinar script (EOD); sam -> seed templates & eval dashboard (tomorrow AM).
ben: QA checklist: signup -> claim -> auto-credit -> run template -> template_run event -> credits deducted UI. test idempotency.
maya: experiment notes: header A/B 50/50; sdr_probe 10% for low-fit leads to measure lift. monitor credit cost vs activation delta.
noah: will push routing rules and document handoff.
ops-bot: experiment flag sdr_probe=10% created.
rachel: drafting copy now, visuals by tomorrow.
sam: will wire telemetry and prepare baseline compare.
maya: thanks team  will post recap + ticket links. :tada:
